title: 1. Introduction to Narrative Arc
use_cases: Use when outlining the structure of a novel to ensure coherent emotional rhythm.
Implement when scripting a film to guarantee that plot twists have logical build‑up.
Configure when drafting a marketing campaign to align audience engagement with a rising narrative arc.
Apply when teaching creative writing to illustrate pacing and conflict escalation.
content: The narrative arc is the overall shape of a story’s progression. It guides readers through an emotional and intellectual journey, ensuring that every twist feels earned and every resolution satisfies the stakes set up earlier.
